MAX_LEVEL = 18

array = [0] * MAX_LEVEL
for i in range(1, MAX_LEVEL):
    array[i] = array[i - 1] * 10 + 1

def recursive_dfs(number, position):
    quotient = number // array[position]
    number %= array[position]
    if number == 0:
        return position * quotient
    return position * quotient + min(
        position + recursive_dfs(array[position] - number, position - 1),
        recursive_dfs(number, position - 1)
    )

import sys

for line in sys.stdin:
    if line.strip():
        input_number = int(line.strip())
        print(recursive_dfs(input_number, MAX_LEVEL - 1))
